claim: The sample demo searches bundled metadata across three separate vaults.
where: Demo route and landing-page first action
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo/; search acme; assert both Work.kdbx entries and ownership.

claim: Demo records use a separate browser-storage namespace and are discarded when starting for real.
sandbox: Fresh browser context with a sentinel real-data key; enter /demo/; assert only demo:vault-cross-search:* is written; choose Start for real.

claim: Reset demo restores the bundled sample data and clears the sample search.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo/; search one known record; activate Reset demo; assert six bundled records return.

claim: The complete sample-demo flow sends no third-party requests.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo/; record all requests during search and reset; allow only the local site origin.

claim: The download page contacts GitHub only after a visitor chooses Download the desktop app.
where: Landing-page download note and privacy policy
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /; intercept GitHub API; assert no cold-load request and one request after explicit download action.

claim: The desktop index includes title, username, URL, and group path, not passwords or notes.
sandbox: In-memory KeePass group with password and notes; serialize the index and assert protected content is absent.

claim: Lock all clears the desktop session index.
sandbox: In-memory session; invoke clear; assert the vault list and activity timestamp are empty.

claim: The desktop app clears a populated session after 15 minutes of inactivity.
where: Landing-page product facts and privacy policy
sandbox: Populated in-memory session with activity time exactly one timeout ago; expire it and assert no vaults or activity timestamp remain.
